body: Hey everyone, and Happy Thanksgiving to all who celebrate! Per a cute idea from @J1mbers, we're giving out a free Turkey Dinner to everyone who logs in before the end of the month (server time). No other conditions - just log in (or relog if you're online now!) to receive it. Big thanks to all of you for continuing to enjoy the server now and over the years. Much love! ❤️ 🦃
